## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Santander, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4.0 km. It starts at Centro Botín, Plaza Emilio Botín, P.º de Pereda, s/n, 39004 Santander, Cantabria, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Centro Botin. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Your ticket to Centro Botín is included on this self-guided audio walking tour of Santander. Please note that an audio tour inside Centro Botín is not provided with this bundle.
>
> After you visit Centro Botín, unpause this tour and follow the waterfront and historic center. Along the way, you’ll discover how Santander grew from a medieval port into a modern coastal city shaped by trade, faith, rebuilding, and its close relationship with the bay. You’ll pass some of Santander’s most important landmarks, including the Cathedral of Santander, Plaza Porticada, and the Paseo Marítimo and Los Raqueros, the much-loved bronze sculptures looking out over the bay. The tour finishes at the lift to Río de la Pila hill, where you can choose to continue to the viewpoint.
>
> Expect a rich mix of experiences: stepping from Renzo Piano’s bold cultural landmark into the older streets around the cathedral, tracing wartime memory underground, and strolling beside open water.
